title: Simple but Efficient
body:
The app is pretty good. The reminders are well done and it does it job.

The only thing it lacks is the ability to sort reminders into groups and I wish I could set the widgets to show the timers

title: Great!
body: The app is very nice and works well! I just wish that you could set alarms or reminders choosing only specific days of the week. This would really make it a 5 stars app! Hope the devs would consider this option. More power!

body: I work for an advertising agency, and this app really helps me in reminding me to do important tasks.

title: A great tool!
body: This is an awesome tool if you use it correctly, you won't need to apologize for forgetting little things again. Essential for interrupt driven schedules.
